visualCharacteristics.purpose: Heading, copy and call to action over a background image
visualCharacteristics.layout: Edge-to-edge band; image covers the block behind the content
visualCharacteristics.locations: Dark blue band (#014d83) with white text on the left and the image (California office-locations map) on the right half from 900px; image stacks above the text on mobile
sections: Find Your Next Role locations band
visualCharacteristics.statement: Blue band (#0071bc) with one large centered white statement paragraph; no image, no CTA
visualCharacteristics.image-cta: Full-bleed photo with a light dark overlay; centered white H2 and a primary CTA button over it

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: heading (H2), paragraphs and a CTA link in its own paragraph
contentPattern.example: Map image, H2 'Find Your Next Role', 3 paragraphs, 'Search open positions' button
contentPattern.image-cta: row 1: background photo; row 2: H2 and a CTA link in its own paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use plain 'Banner' for text over a full-cover photo; add 'locations' when the image is an illustration or map that must stay fully visible beside the text. A lone link becomes a button. Use 'statement' for a single large statement on a blue band (no image), and 'image-cta' for a centered heading and CTA button over a full-bleed photo.
